title: Gospel as steady business, and high costs of pop albums
summary: McRae says gospel is a low-overhead business, while pop albums cost tens of thousands and the industry is in a slump.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums
